tasks.name: Temporal worker Tailscale health (all Temporal-backed apps)
tasks.schedule: every 1 minute plus RunAtLoad
tasks.notes: Replaces octospark-temporal-route-health (2026-09-04). For every app in config/docker-apps.json with temporal.enabled (Octospark prod+staging, Trace Learn prod+staging) it reads TEMPORAL_ADDRESS from the running api container, TCP-connects to the Hetzner temporal-server from inside that container, then checks the host utun route and host TCP once per distinct target. On failure: tailscale down/up, re-check, restart each app's configured worker containers and kickstart configured launchd runners (com.octospark.auto-fix-runner.{staging,prod}). Repairs rate-limited to 1 per 10 min; each run killed after 170s. No 1Password dependency. Add an app by editing config/docker-apps.json only.

Docker Desktop on macOS starts at user LOGIN not boot, so restart:always alone cannot help - a 2026-07-26 reboot left api.tracelearn.app on 502 for ~20h; tx-agent-kit additionally runs with restart:no. NOT a deploy: no build, pull, secrets or migrations. Idempotent. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/ensure-dockerised-apps-online/disabled (all) or disabled.<app-id> (one).

tasks.name: CI VM janitor (Colima 'ci' prune + fstrim, orphaned CI container reaper)
tasks.schedule: daily at 04:10 local
tasks.notes: Second Docker daemon on this host. host-docker-cleanup (03:30) only ever talks to Docker Desktop; the self-hosted Actions runners build against the Colima 'ci' VM (DOCKER_HOST=unix://~/.colima/ci/docker.sock) and nothing cleaned it. By 2026-09-08 that VM held 398 orphaned anonymous volumes (36GB) and its sparse datadisk had grown to 108GB on the host, helping push the boot volume to 98% full. Prunes anonymous volumes, dangling images and build cache >168h INSIDE the VM, then runs fstrim so the freed guest blocks are actually returned to the host: the datadisk is a raw sparse image that only ever grows, so without the trim the reclaim is invisible to macOS (2026-09-08: prune freed 34GB in-guest, fstrim took the host file 108GB -> 27GB). Never touches named volumes (CI postgres/clickhouse/minio/langfuse depend on them), running containers, or the base image cache. Also reaps orphaned ephemeral CI containers on the HOST daemon whose creating shell PID is dead and which are older than 3h - trace-learn's mobile-readiness run-environment.sh removes its detached cloud-sql-proxy from an EXIT trap, which never fires when a cancelled workflow SIGKILLs the shell, leaving an authenticated prod Cloud SQL tunnel open (8 leaked over 7 days). Scheduled 04:10 so it never contends with the 03:30 host janitor. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/ci-vm-cleanup/disabled.

tasks.name: Local inference server (llama.cpp, coding agents)
tasks.schedule: KeepAlive daemon, RunAtLoad, ThrottleInterval 30s
tasks.notes: Local inference server for coding agents, OpenAI-compatible at http://100.77.197.1:8080/v1 over the tailnet. One resident model, multiplexed over --parallel slots with continuous batching, so another worker costs its KV cache rather than another copy of the weights. DEFAULT MODEL: Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf (15.3GB, dense 27B, vision-capable, reasoning). Chosen 2026-09-09 over Ornith-1.5-35B (also in ~/models, 20.2GB) after a turns-to-green bake-off compiling real Bevy 0.19 output with cargo: with a 12-turn budget BOTH reached 4/4, and total wall time was a dead heat (Qwen 195.5s vs Ornith 200.7s). They differ in shape, not speed: Qwen takes fewer, slower turns (median 2) and is very consistent (46-51s every episode), while Ornith takes more, cheaper turns (median 3 at ~10s) with a better median (28.6s) but a bad tail (one episode burned 11 turns / 120s). Qwen picked for predictability under unattended runs. NOTE an earlier 5-turn cap made both look like 75% failures and made Ornith look 3.2x faster; both were artifacts of the cap. Neither model one-shots Bevy 0.19 - always >=2 turns. REASONING: Qwen3.8-27B is a reasoning model and WILL spend its whole token budget thinking and return nothing if left unbounded (measured: 142.9s, 11419 chars of reasoning, 0 chars of answer). LLAMA_SERVE_REASONING_BUDGET=512 + LLAMA_SERVE_REASONING_EFFORT=low fixes it (16.1s, finish_reason=stop). reasoning_effort=minimal returns HTTP 500 in this build; the /no_think prompt prefix does NOT work, only chat_template_kwargs or these flags. SLOTS: 2 x 131072 ctx - one chat session occupies exactly ONE slot (verified via /slots), so 4 slots just left 3 idle. PREFILL is the real constraint on this dense model: 29.9s at 8k, 89.0s at 24k, 112.8s at 48k, so keep agent auto-compaction ON with a threshold well below 131k. Prompt-cache reuse is worth ~26x on a stable prefix (22.4s cold vs 0.8s cached), and compaction destroys that prefix, so compact rarely rather than never. This box is an M4 Max (40 GPU cores, 546GB/s), not an Ultra. iogpu.wired_limit_mb stays at the system default. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/llama-server/disabled then launchctl kill TERM.
